verification.subject: Verify your SkyBook email
verification.title: Verify your email
verification.intro: Thanks for signing up for SkyBook. Use the code below to verify your email address:
verification.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't create a SkyBook account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your SkyBook password
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your SkyBook password. Tap the button below to choose a new one:
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in 20 minutes. If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.
